prompts.title: Viral Photo Collage Prompt Instagram
prompts.prompt:
Use my reference photograph as the ONLY identity reference. Recreate the composition of the model image exactly, replacing the original woman with me in every appearance.
EXTREME IDENTITY LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY
Preserve my exact same face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, smile, facial shape, natural skin tone and texture, apparent age, ethnicity, hair, hair color, and body proportions. I must look like the same real person in every frame, without changing my identity, making me look younger, making me slimmer, or creating a generic AI face.
Create a vertical, cheerful, super-realistic photographic collage on a smooth warm beige wall. Place approximately seven vintage rectangular frames made of rustic, weathered wood, overlapping and arranged dynamically. My body must interact naturally with the frames, creating a convincing three-dimensional effect.
At the top center, show me full-body, casually sitting on several frames, with one leg bent and the other extending downward in front of them. I am smiling at the camera and raising one hand in a peace sign. I wear a fitted petrol-blue T-shirt, straight-leg blue jeans, and clean white sneakers.
Inside the other frames, show repeated versions of me with the exact same face and outfit, performing different expressions and gestures:
• Laughing with my eyes closed.
• Looking surprised with both hands on my cheeks.
• Making a heart shape with my hands.
• Taking a selfie with a phone.
• Hands on my cheeks with an excited smile.
• Raising both hands in celebration.
Decorate the empty spaces with hand-drawn doodle-style illustrations: red hearts, yellow stars, a small crown, excitement lines, and speech bubbles containing the following large, perfectly legible phrases according to subject mood:
“BEST DAY EVER!”
“OOPS!”
“SO HAPPY!”
“HAHA!”
“LOVE THIS!”
“LITTLE MOMENTS!”
Add three vintage cameras placed decoratively around the collage.
Photography: hyper-realistic editorial photography, warm and even studio lighting, soft natural shadows behind the frames, clearly visible wood texture, convincing three-dimensional depth, realistic skin texture, anatomically correct hands, sharp focus, clean colors, youthful, spontaneous and playful atmosphere, ultra-high detail, 8K quality, vertical 2:3 composition.
NEGATIVE PROMPT
Different face between frames, multiple identities, altered facial features, rejuvenated appearance, modified body, plastic skin, deformed faces, incorrect hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, floating frames, body passing through objects, illegible text, misspelled letters, low resolution, blur, excessive yellow lighting, cartoon style, artificial appearance, generic AI face, inconsistent hairstyle, inconsistent clothing, distorted anatomy, unnatural poses.

prompts.title: Man Doodle Line Art Collage Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 3x3 editorial lifestyle collage featuring the same mature man 
(match the attached reference photo) portrayed in nine imaginative professions, 
hobbies, and dream scenarios. Each panel blends real photography with hand-drawn black ink doodle illustrations, as if simple sketch art has come to life around 
him. Minimalist white studio background, soft diffused lighting, subtle natural 
shadows, thin white borders separating each panel in a clean magazine-style grid. 
Hyper-realistic photography combined with fine, monochrome black ink doodles and pencil-sketch texture. Professional DSLR quality, sharp focus, photorealistic 
rendering, 8K resolution, premium commercial/editorial advertising quality.

Keep the man's facial identity, skin tone, hairstyle, sunglasses, expression, and 
natural body proportions perfectly consistent across every panel.

Panel 1 – Surfing: riding a surfboard in an energetic pose, surrounded by 
expressive black ink sketches of waves, spray, and motion lines.

Panel 2 – Astronaut: wearing a realistic NASA-style suit, floating weightlessly 
with a rocket launching beneath him, hand-drawn stars and planets around him.

Panel 3 – Reading on clouds: lying comfortably on a fluffy white cloud, 
surrounded by cozy hand-drawn study-room doodles (books, lamp, tea cup).

Panel 4 – Scientist: white lab coat, examining a glass test tube, surrounded by 
hand-drawn molecular structures, chemical formulas, bubbles, and a comic speech bubble reading "PromptPlum!"

Panel 5 – Gardener: kneeling beside a raised wooden garden bed watering fresh 
vegetable plants, surrounded by illustrated herbs, leaves, flowers, tools, and insects.

Panel 6 – Meditation: sitting cross-legged in lotus pose atop a large illustrated 
lotus flower, glowing aura circles and inspirational doodles behind him.

Panel 7 – Chef: chef's uniform, holding tomatoes and zucchini, surrounded by 
hand-drawn steam curls and kitchen doodles.

Panel 8 – Carpenter: protective gloves and safety glasses, hammering at a 
workbench, surrounded by hand-drawn tools, rulers, screws, and wood shavings.

Panel 9 – Artist: paint-splattered apron, mid-brushstroke on a landscape 
painting, surrounded by hand-drawn paint splashes, tubes, and sketch lines.

Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Graphic Soul
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed black-and-white studio portrait of a stylish person, captured in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
Subject & Outfit:
The subject is seated on a minimal metal folding chair, wearing an oversized tailored black blazer layered over a clean black shirt, paired with relaxed black trousers and chunky white-colored sneakers. Accessories include sleek dark sunglasses and a subtle minimal chain necklace. The outfit must appear crisp, structured, and completely wrinkle-free with clearly visible fabric texture and sharp detailing.
Pose & Expression:
Relaxed yet confident seated pose. One arm (right arm) is resting comfortably over the backrest of the chair, with the hand hanging naturally, while the other arm rests loosely on his thigh.
Legs are spread naturally, not overly wide, maintaining a balanced and grounded stance. Adding depth and a subtle dynamic to the pose. Calm, self-assured expression with a composed gaze directed toward the camera.
Composition & Framing (STRICT):
Full-body composition, subject centered with balanced negative space. A polished editorial look. No cropping of head or feet.
Lighting:
Soft professional studio lighting with gentle directional shadows falling subtly toward the right side of the floor. Even exposure across face and outfit — no harsh shadows or underexposure. Clean tonal contrast in monochrome.
Background:
Seamless pure white studio background with a soft gradient falloff, maintaining a clean minimalist aesthetic.
Graphic Elements (Doodles):
Surrounding the subject are bold, hand-drawn graffiti-style doodles in black, white, and vibrant orange accents. Elements include lightning bolts, arrows, stars, swirls, and abstract strokes. Integrated motivational text in a hand-drawn style:
“PURPOSE, CREATE YOUR PATH,”
“FAITH”
“FOCUS”
Doodles must be arranged in a visually balanced, symmetrical composition around the subject and must not cover or fill the entire background.
The doodles should feel energetic and dynamic while framing the subject without overlapping the face. Bright orange accents should pop against the monochrome scene.
Style & Quality:
Ultra-sharp focus, cinematic contrast, editorial fashion aesthetic, 8K resolution, high detail retention, clean monochrome subject with vibrant graphic highlights.

If any color appears outside the doodles, the result is incorrect.

prompts.title: Retro Beat in Adidas Blue
prompts.prompt:
Create a vibrant, mixed-media image that blends photography with illustrative doodles. It has a strong commercial streetwear vibe, heavily featuring Adidas branding. Here is a detailed breakdown of the image:
1. The Subject & Outfit
The Model: A young man (uploaded photo for 100.999% facial reference) wearing sunglasses stands in a dynamic, confident pose, looking directly at the camera. He appears to be mid-stride or performing a dance move.
The "All-Blue" Look: He is dressed almost entirely in shades of electric and royal blue:
A blue t-shirt featuring a large white Adidas Trefoil logo.
A heavy, oversized blue jacket with a textured (possibly fleece) lining.
Dark blue denim jeans with the cuffs rolled up, revealing white socks.
Crisp white sneakers (likely Adidas Superstars or Stan Smiths).
2. Graphic Elements (Doodles)
The photo is overlaid with white, hand-drawn style illustrations that interact with the subject:
"Mic Drop": The man's right hand is raised, and white lines representing the iconic Adidas "Three Stripes" are drawn dropping from his fingers. Just below them is a doodle of a microphone, suggesting a rap or performance theme.
Boombox: To his left, a white doodle of a classic boombox radio floats in the air, with lines indicating sound coming out of it.
Cracked Floor: Under his feet, white lines depict a cracked surface, as if his step was heavy enough to shatter the ground (or perhaps referencing "breaking" dance).
Clothing Accents: White dashed lines are drawn over his jeans to accentuate the seams.
3. Background & Color Palette
Monochrome Blue: The background is a solid, flat sky blue.
Liquid Shapes: Large, abstract shapes of a slightly darker blue float around the subject, resembling liquid blobs or paint splashes, adding depth to the composition.
Branding: A large white Adidas Trefoil logo floats near the bottom right.
Overall Mood
The image conveys energy, youth culture, music (specifically hip-hop), and urban fashion. The combination of the photo with the playful doodles gives it a fresh, artistic advertising aesthetic.
